observations: Photo 0 shows a pile of used automotive parts.
Several items are wrapped in clear plastic film.
The items visible are engine blocks and transmission cases.
No brand names, model numbers, or identification plates are legible in the photo.

claims.claim: Toyota Corolla 2010 engine and gear box 2ZR
claims.evidence: The specific Toyota Corolla 2010 2ZR engine and gearbox are not visible in the photo; only generic engine blocks and cases are shown.

risks.risk: The items may be from a different model or year than the one claimed.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine identification plate (VIN/Engine Number) and the gearbox identification plate.
risks.if_unproven: as a generic used engine and gearbox without a specific model.

risks.risk: The engine may have internal damage or excessive wear.
risks.proof: A video of the engine being tested with a compression gauge or a dyno.
risks.if_unproven: as a non-functional or heavily damaged unit.

risks.risk: The gearbox may have internal wear or leaks.
risks.proof: A video showing the gearbox being shifted through all gears while the engine is running.
risks.if_unproven: as a gearbox requiring a rebuild.

proof_requests: Photo of the engine identification plate showing the engine number and model.
Photo of the gearbox identification plate.
Video of the engine running and the gearbox being shifted.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
